name: Level-scaled melee damage for the Honored Ancestor and the Spectral Warden (COA-6085, COA-6058)
contract: The Honored Ancestor (51265, Ancestor's Call 804834), the Spectral Warden (100481, 805716) and the Spectral
Scythe (250305) are guardians with level 1 templates. Guardian::InitStatsForLevel sets their level from the owner
but has no damage case for them, so they kept level 1 weapon damage (min about 4) and hit for 2-3. A
PLAYERHOOK_ON_AFTER_GUARDIAN_INIT_STATS_FOR_LEVEL script now gives them the creature base damage and attack power
of their level, as the Ranger's Wingman companions already get. The Scythe is summoned by Soul Strike procs and
is covered by the same entry list.

steps.label: Let login and level scaling settle
SETUP: the Honored Ancestor is summoned
DISCRIMINATING: the level 60 Honored Ancestor's weapon is not level 1 damage
SETUP: the Spectral Warden is summoned
DISCRIMINATING: the level 43 Spectral Warden's weapon is not level 1 damage
